# 04.1 Course Wrap-Up and Next Steps

## You Built the Foundation

You can now write a complete HTML document from scratch — headings, paragraphs, links, and images, all properly nested, indented, and linked with the right attributes. That is the structural foundation of every web page.

![Conceptual illustration showing the three core web technologies as layers of a house: HTML as a gray concrete foundation labeled 'Structure (HTML)', CSS as a colorful painted wall with paint roller labeled 'Style (CSS)', and JavaScript as glowing light bulbs and gears above the wall labeled 'Behavior (JavaScript)', with a clean flat design and friendly colors showing how each layer builds on the one below](./.learn/assets/web-technology-stack.png)

CSS adds the paint — colors, layout, and fonts. JavaScript adds the lights — interactivity, animations, and behavior. Together, they turn your solid HTML structure into a living, breathing web page. You have the foundation. The rest is just building upward.
